items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: You ever heard of Bolegs? Mm-hmm. I haven't heard of them.

ctx.x: He was a trumpet, he was an E flat trumpet player. Really? I didn't know. In Brasgow. He played trumpet, but I don't know. He played trumpet. But I don't know. Yeah, I heard him on piano. I heard him on piano. I heard him on trumpet. You know what we did? That's before, when they, before they put up the band, me and my brother played guitar, First and Liberty. You know that shop you went to, First and Liberty? First time. Him on guitar. I played the bass. And Walmart bro played the violin. Walmart bro played with…
Now who is Bolegs? What did he do? Good.
